anatomy.flutter: Stat(label, value, delta, betterWhen, hint, state, message, disabled, disabledReason) builds Disabled > Semantics > Column[StyledText(label), figure ConstrainedBox(minHeight)/Align, optional delta row Wrap/Row] with a separate exported StatDeltaMark(delta, betterWhen) widget, matching stat.tsx's own StatDeltaMark export.

api.flutter: StatState enum {ready, loading, error, empty} with a .blank getter (error || empty); StatDirection enum {up, down, flat} carrying glyph/sign/word per variant; StatDelta = ({String value, StatDirection direction}) typedef; Stat's constructor mirrors every web prop 1:1 plus a Flutter-only disabledReason for tooltip text.
api.web: StatState = 'ready'|'loading'|'error'|'empty'; StatDirection = 'up'|'down'|'flat'; StatDelta = {value: string; direction: StatDirection}; Stat's props are label/value/delta/betterWhen/hint/state/message/disabled/className — the same shape, with the doc comment's own 'Not ported: nothing' line in stat.dart confirming full parity.

states.flutter: Stat.build() branches figure on loading (Skeleton sized figureSkeleton) vs. blank (em dash + Semantics 'No value') vs. ready (ContentChange(replayKey: state) wrapping StyledText), and the delta row similarly branches Skeleton(deltaSkeleton) vs. StatDeltaMark vs. null, matching the seven-row state table (rest/hover/focus/pressed n/a, loading, success n/a, error, disabled, empty) stat.tsx's own doc comment lays out.
states.web: stat.tsx's doc comment states the identical state table verbatim (hover/focus-visible/pressed are N/A because 'a Stat has no action to succeed at'; loading skeletons the figure and delta only; error becomes an em dash with message; disabled is opacity-45 + aria-disabled; empty is an em dash with message), and Stat's JSX implements each branch exactly as described.

disabled.flutter: Stat wraps its body in Disabled(disabled: disabled, reason: disabledReason) and Semantics(enabled: !disabled, child: body) — the doc comment states 'disabled: opacity-45, aria-disabled. Contrast-exempt (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, trap 9) — it only has to read as unavailable, and the shimmer is what separates it from loading.'
disabled.web: The root <div> carries data-disabled={disabled || undefined} aria-disabled={disabled || undefined} className={cn('min-w-0', disabled && 'opacity-45', className)}, matching the 45% opacity and aria-disabled semantics exactly.

interaction.flutter: Stat's own doc comment states 'The host owns the box, and the host owns any interaction: a Stat is not a control' — there is no GestureDetector, Focus, or key handling anywhere in stat.dart.

semantics.flutter: StatDeltaMark wraps its Row in Semantics(label: '${delta.direction.word},', child: ...) — announcing 'Up,'/'Down,'/'No change,' before the numeric value — and the direction is carried three ways as the doc comment states: glyph shape (arrowUp/arrowDown/minus), the sign written onto the magnitude (+/−/none), and the Semantics label word.
semantics.web: StatDeltaMark renders {word},{sign}{delta.value} — the identical three-way encoding (shape, sign, sr-only word) the doc comment calls out under 'Trap 11: a mark whose only difference between states is hue is ONE signal, not two.'
